text: To talk to a crew member in Slack, open their Integrations.
Choose Slack. We recommend giving them their own bot, so they answer only as themselves, in any channel they're invited to.
Create a Slack app for them. The exact steps and permissions are listed right here.
Paste its two tokens, then choose Save and test.
Now invite them to a channel, and mention them. They reply in the thread, and anything important waits for your approval, right there in Slack.
